# Robot Kyle

Source: https://github.com/unity3d-jp/fuze-vj-kit/tree/master/vjkit/Assets/VJKit/Models/Robot%20Kyle

Downloaded on 2026-10-11 from Unity Technologies Japan's public repository.
The repository's license for items outside CreativeCommons3 is preserved in SOURCE_LICENSE.md.
This model is outside that folder. No CreativeCommons3 asset was imported.

Imported files: Robot Kyle.fbx, Robot_Color.tga, Robot_Normal.tga, original material files.
The upgrade generates a Standard material for Unity's Built-in pipeline and a body mesh
without head/neck triangles for first-person rendering. The full original model is shown
in the observer view. Original repository material GUID references are not used.
